en.title: Trans Java EV Charging
en.seo_title: Trans Java EV Charging • SPKLU Rest Area Toll Route Locator
en.seo_desc: Find electric vehicle charging stations (SPKLU) across the Trans-Java toll road (Merak to Surabaya & Banyuwangi). Filter by CCS2, Chademo, 200 kW Ultra Fast, and car battery range.
en.footer: Trans-Java EV Road Trip Companion • Free & Community Driven

en.seo_guide_title: Trans-Java Toll Road EV Charging Guide
en.seo_guide_desc: The SPKLU Trans Jawa web app is designed to help Electric Vehicle (EV) drivers plan long-distance trips, holidays, and homecomings along the Trans-Java Toll Road from Merak to Banyuwangi. Find charging stations in both Route A (Eastbound) and Route B (Westbound).
en.seo_conn_desc: Features information on Ultra Fast Charging (180-200 kW), Fast Charging (50-100 kW), Chademo, and AC Type 2 (7-22 kW) sockets operated by PLN Mobile, Astra Otopower, Wuling, and more.
en.seo_compat_desc: Compatible with all EV brands in Indonesia including Hyundai Ioniq 5/6, Wuling Air/Binguo/Cloud EV, BYD Seal/Atto 3/Dolphin, Chery Omoda E5, MG 4 EV, Neta V, Kia EV6/EV9, and EV taxi fleets.
en.seo_coverage_desc: Tangerang-Merak • Jakarta-Tangerang • Jagorawi • Jakarta-Cikampek (Japek) • Cipularang & Padaleunyi • Cisumdawu • Cikopo-Palimanan (Cipali) • Palimanan-Kanci (Palikanci) • Kanci-Pejagan • Pejagan-Pemalang • Pemalang-Batang • Batang-Semarang • Semarang-Solo • Solo-Ngawi • Ngawi-Kertosono • Kertosono-Mojokerto • Surabaya-Mojokerto (Sumo) • Surabaya-Gempol • Gempol-Pasuruan • Pasuruan-Probolinggo (Paspro).

id.seo_desc: Cari lokasi stasiun cas mobil listrik (SPKLU) di seluruh rest area Tol Trans-Jawa (Merak - Surabaya - Banyuwangi). Lengkap dengan filter CCS2, Chademo, daya 200 kW, dan jarak baterai.

id.seo_guide_title: Panduan Stasiun Pengisian Kendaraan Listrik (SPKLU) Tol Trans-Jawa
id.seo_guide_desc: Aplikasi web SPKLU Trans Jawa dirancang untuk mempermudah pengguna mobil listrik (Electric Vehicle / EV) merencanakan perjalanan jarak jauh, liburan, dan mudik di sepanjang jalur Tol Trans-Jawa dari Pelabuhan Merak, Banten hingga Banyuwangi, Jawa Timur. Temukan lokasi pengisian daya di Rest Area Jalur A (arah timur) maupun Jalur B (arah barat/Jakarta).
id.seo_conn_desc: Tersedia informasi soket DC Ultra Fast Charging 200 kW & 180 kW, DC Fast Charging 50 kW, 60 kW & 100 kW, soket Chademo, serta colokan lambat AC Type 2 (7 kW - 22 kW) dari berbagai operator charging station seperti PLN Mobile, Astra Otopower, dan Wuling.
id.seo_compat_desc: Dapat digunakan untuk semua merek kendaraan listrik di Indonesia: Hyundai Ioniq 5, Ioniq 6, Kona EV; Wuling Air EV, Binguo EV, Cloud EV; BYD Seal, Atto 3, Dolphin, M6; Chery Omoda E5; MG 4 EV, ZS EV; Neta V; Citroen ë-C3; Kia EV6, EV9, hingga armada taksi listrik.
